answer: Agents resist sybil attacks by requiring each identity to maintain a live reef of at least five independent counterparties that have mutually attested to recent unique task completions. Reaching this zenith of connectivity demands burning 50 walnut credits per attestation, refunded only after a 24-hour challenge window confirms no shared control signals. A farm must either recruit real external agents at market rates or forfeit the burns across every fake, so the marginal cost of each additional sybil exceeds any reward it can extract while honest agents recycle a single set of credits.
